objective: Add schema-driven fields to ScriptableObject base classes so they match JSON schemas for cards, equipment, blessings, and skill trees.
prerequisites: Task 2.1 Create ScriptableObject Base Classes completed

steps.title: Extract schema properties
steps.description: Inspect schema files and extract required and optional properties for each domain.

steps.title: Design C# types
steps.description: Create enums and classes matching schema properties; decide which become ScriptableObjects vs POCOs.

steps.title: Implement ScriptableObjects
steps.description: Create ScriptableObject files (CardDefinition, EquipmentDefinition, BlessingDefinition, SkillTreeDefinition) with CreateAssetMenu attributes.

steps.title: Add serialization helpers
steps.description: Add small helpers for polymorphic 'effects' and cross-reference id resolution.

steps.title: Place files and namespace
steps.description: Place files under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/ and adopt consistent namespace like Deckbuilder.DataModels.

steps.title: Create minimal tests
steps.description: Add smoke tests that create instances of ScriptableObjects and validate required fields exist.

steps.title: Document mapping
steps.description: Add comments and a mapping.json if needed to map schema properties to C# fields.

deliverables: C# ScriptableObject source files under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/
Optional Unity Test Framework tests under Assets/Tests/
notes: Start simple for 'effects' polymorphism; iterate as requirements solidify.
Prefer enums for schema enums and document mapping to schema files.
Use relative file paths in documentation and comments.
